prompt: Create an original 150 second chamber classical instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: string quartet, clarinet. Style: interlocking counterpoint and expressive legato. Tempo approximately 82 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A dramatic and melancholic orchestral waltz, featuring a full string section, woodwinds, brass, and light percussion. The piece builds from a delicate opening to a grand, sweeping climax before returning to a more subdued ending. It evokes a sense of romanticism and nostalgia.
description.zh: 一首戏剧性且忧郁的管弦乐华尔兹，包含完整的弦乐部分、木管乐器、铜管乐器和轻柔的打击乐。乐曲从精致的开场逐渐发展到宏大而磅礴的高潮，然后回归到较为柔和的结尾。它唤起了一种浪漫主义和怀旧感。
